articleTitle: On the Design of a Multiband Microstrip Patch Antenna by Introducing a Defected Ground Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A rectangular inset-fed microstrip patch antenna with a defected ground structure to operate at the 2.4 GHz (ISM band), 5.7 GHz (WLAN band), and 6.9 and 8.5 GHz (WBAN band) is presented here. The antenna was first designed only for the ISM band, and later, the same antenna was improvised by imposing specific defects as various slots in the reference plane of the antenna to use for multiband applications at WLAN and WBAN bands. The proposed model was designed in a full-wave simulation tool and has been verified through measurements of return loss and radiation patterns of a fabricated prototype that showed reasonable agreements between simulated and measured values.

articleTitle: Turning Door Frames into Cameras for 3D Non-line-of-sight Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging reconstructs scenes lying outside the line of sight of an observer. We demonstrate a new passive 3D NLOS imaging system that reconstructs, in 3D, the contents of hidden rooms from 2D photographs of light reaching a visible ceiling patch outside the room.

articleTitle: High density Photonic Tensor Core for Matrix-Vector Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: With the increasing demanding for data processing and application-specific hardware, photonics can out-perform electrical IC in terms of speed and energy saving. Here, we present our Photonic Tensor Core architecture, showing high components density, with error rate lower than 4% on image edge detection.

articleTitle: 3D Laser Deposition of Inorganic Transparent Materials for Advanced Optics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A novel Additive Manufacturing (AM) process is presented for depositing inorganic glasses with sufficient quality and precision for fused multi-component and gradient index (GRIN) optics. The CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser is used to evaporate and sinter the suspension of oxide nanopowder and to produce inorganic glasses.

articleTitle: Morpho Butterfly-Inspired Sensors Created by Multi-Photon Polymerization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Morpho butterfly-inspired structures that form the basis for new photonic-plasmonic sensors were fabricated by multi-photon lithography. Structural parameters of the fabricated device meet targeted values with minimum deviation. Preliminary simulations confirm an expected optical properties.

articleTitle: Power and brightness scaling of GaAs-based diode lasers and modules for direct and pump applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present an overview of recent developments of brilliant high-power diode lasers and diode laser systems as direct or pump sources, containing high duty cycle and CW systems, ranging from 665 nm for alexandrite, via 780 nm for thulium to 970 nm for Yb:YAG.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of SOI based broadband Grating Coupler
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We have designed a Silicon on Insulator(SOI) based broadband grating coupler using Inverse Design approach. Using this method, we have achieved maximum coupling efficiency of 67%-84% with 3db bandwidth of 75nm-115nm, depending on the partial etch depth.

articleTitle: InAs/InAsSb Type-II Stained Layer Superlattice Infrared Detectors and Focal Plane Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The Gallium-free InAs/InAsSb type-II strained-layer superlattice (T2SLS) is an adjustable band gap, broadband III-V infrared detector material that has emerged in recent years as an alternative to the more established InAs/GaSb type-II superlattice (T2SL). The InAs/InAsSb T2SLS has been shown to be highly effective when implemented in the mid-wavelength infrared (MWIR) with the nBn [1] or XBn [2] , [3] detector architecture. The InAs/InAsSb T2SLS high operating temperature (HOT) unipolar barrier infrared detector (BIRD) focal plane array (FPA) [4] , [5] operates at significantly higher temperatures than the MWIR market-leading InSb FPA, while retaining the same III-V semiconductor manufacturability and affordability benefits. However, there are significant challenges in extending to long wavelengths. For the long wavelength infrared (LWIR) and very long cutoff wavelength infrared (VLWIR), InAs/InAsSb T2SLS detectors with n -type absorbers are limited in their attainable quantum efficiency (QE) due to shorter hole diffusion lengths and relatively modest absorption coefficients.

articleTitle: Multiport Concentrators for Free Space Optical Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Multiport optical concentrators are fabricated by femtosecond laser irradiation of fused silica followed by selective etching. Applications include multiple-output coupling to small-area, high-speed photodetectors for free space optical communications. A 1x7 device is demonstrated and advantages over ball lenses are discussed.

articleTitle: Fabrication of the Next Generation of Drive Electronics for Infrared Scene Projectors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Advancements in the development of Infrared Scene Projectors require updated electronics to control such devices. This paper highlights the design and fabrication of the next generation of drive electronics, which will include double the digital and analog channels and allow the use of faster framerates.

articleTitle: CDS’s Infrared LED Scene Projector System as a Platform Product
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: With recent improvements to Chip Design System’s (CDS’s) Infrared LED Scene Projector (IRSP) System, we are happy to announce our IRSP System as a platform product.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Effects in Mie Resonant Plasmonic Lattices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We analyze second-harmonic generation at the condition when multipole Mie lattice resonances are excited in plasmonic nanoparticles. We study various excitation conditions, nanoparticle array periods, and coupling of electric quadrupole and magnetic dipole in the nanoparticle lattice linked to symmetry breaking.

articleTitle: 2D Relative Phase Reconstruction of Low-contrast Plasma Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recently reported 1D phase reconstruction from low contrast and noisy interferometry of Cu plasma is compared to 2D reconstruction with the Fourier Transform Method. Plasma density results of two different measurement campaigns with electrically exploded wires show effects of signal-to-noise ratios and intensity variation.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared optical phased array in an InP-based platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We develop a 16-channel aperiodic optical phased array for beam steering in the mid-infrared spectral region in an InGaAs/InP platform. The device consists of an MMI light splitting tree, thermally isolated thermo-optic phase shifters, and power-balanced emission gratings.

articleTitle: Novel Photonic Crystals for Beam Control in the Near-Infrared Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This work explores the design, fabrication, and testing of spatially variant photonic crystals to achieve beam control in the near-infrared spectrum. These capabilities can improve optical systems for increased transmission and direction of light.

articleTitle: Label-free Biomarker Detection Using Dielectrophoresis and Localized Surface Plasmonic Resonance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We have utilized the dielectrophoretic force of short single-stranded DNA molecules to manipulate molecules around Au nanoparticles and studied the effects of the localized plasmon resonance response of Au nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Cryogenic Optical Interconnects for Infrared Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Silicon (Si) photonics is poised to make an impact in critical military applications requiring high-speed and high-bandwidth interconnects. Current efforts for military applications are focused on high-pixel count (e.g. > Megapixel) and fast frame rate (e.g. > 1 kHz) infrared (IR) focal plane arrays (FPA) that operate at cryogenic temperatures and produce large amounts of data (e.g. 20 Gbps and beyond). Traditional electronic interconnects are no longer viable for these high-performance imaging applications; optical interconnects however are considered viable due to extremely high bandwidth and low thermal conductance. Progress toward developing a wavelength division multiplexed (WDM) scalable optical interconnect architecture, for use in cryogenic environments is reported.

articleTitle: Low-Noise Hybrid Photonic Integrated Violet and Blue Lasers for Quantum Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Compact, single-frequency and low-noise integrated photonic laser diodes emitting in the violet (~412 nm) and blue (461 nm) regime are demonstrated. Hybrid-integration of the III-Nitride edge-type laser diodes to a butt-coupled on-chip high-Q resonator was used to achieved ultra-low phase-noise laser operation with ~36 dB side-mode suppression ratio. Both a CMOS-compatible PIC chip with SiN core as well as a new class of PIC platform with crystalline III-Nitride heterostructures was developed and evaluated. Successful demonstration of laser self-injection locking with ultra-narrow emission linewidth was demonstrated for both material platforms. Emission linewidth of only ~ 1 MHz was determined with an external-cavity reference laser implying state-of-the-art phase noise performance and offering a vastly improved form factor. The performance metrics of this novel type of laser suggest the potential implementation of this new technology in next generation, portable quantum systems.

articleTitle: Generalized Constructal Framework for Two-Dimensional Colloidal Particle Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The natural evolution of various physical phenomena can be described by the constructal law. Here, we develop a generalized constructal model for colloidal particle assembly in 2D systems. Ultimately, this general framework can be applied to evaluate particle behavior in response to any pairwise interaction.

articleTitle: Phase-Change Metamaterial Infrared Scene Projector
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: To address the needs of the next-generation of infrared scene projectors, we present the concept of a spatial light modulator (SLM) consisting of a hybridized metamaterial surface and phase change material. Initial results demonstrate the SLM’s ability to achieve better than 1 KHz modulation.

articleTitle: Modelling the Training Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In this paper we propose a parametric model of the training process which includes the skill increase and retention during training. The model is verified with the data from 22 subjects performing tasks in a flight simulator. The resulting computational model estimates the behavioral score.

articleTitle: Ground penetrating radar imaging via the linear sampling method under a phase-encoded formulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a ground penetrating radar (GPR) imaging study using a linear sampling method (LSM) variant. The phase-encoded LSM (PE-LSM) is formulated for improved performance from limited apertures, which are relevant to GPR but challenging for conventional LSM. We demonstrate improved performance using simulated data.

articleTitle: A Laboratory Imaging System at 600 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper presents the early effort to develop a non-coherent THz radar imaging system operating from 580 to 620 GHz using readily available components. The effort is a baseline for developing a coherent system. The frequency and angular responses are presented along with initial imaging.

articleTitle: Digital FIR Boosting to Correct IRLED RIIC Analog Delay
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Over the past year, CDS IRSP systems have seen many improvements, and the next generation of technology is under development. In preparation for the next-generation platform, several regressions were identified to be corrected. This paper explores these issues and a potential workaround.

Author Keywords: Infrared light emitting diodes scene projectors

articleTitle: Intraband Colloidal Quantum Dots for Low-Cost Mid-Wavelength Infrared Detectors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The paper presents low-cost infrared photodetectors fabricated from silver selenide intraband colloidal quantum dots. Various materials and device design approaches are discussed for the use of this new class of semiconductor nanomaterials in mid-wavelength infrared sensors and imagers.

articleTitle: Multiple Close Support Electronics (CSE) Advancements for Infrared Scene Projector Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Infrared scene projector(IRSPs) are critical laboratory tools for setup, calibration and testing infrared imaging systems. These projectors are progressing to handle higher resolution, faster frame-rates and improvement in thermal performance. This hardware architecture is a configurable and scalable solution used to drive these high-speed systems.

articleTitle: Mitigating Striations on Infrared LEDs through Application of DAC Corrections
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: When displaying images on our infrared LED scene projector, horizontal striations are a regularly seen yet unwanted phenomenon. This paper discusses the steps taken to mitigate such striations.

articleTitle: Short-Wavelength InAs-Based Quantum Cascade Detector Operating at 2.7 μm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present an InAs/AlAsSb Quantum Cascade Detector (QCD) lattice-matched to InAs, detecting at 2.7 μm, with a room temperature responsivity of 5.63 mA/W and a detectivity of 1.14 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> Jones. A diffraction grating allows for top-side illumination of the QCD.

articleTitle: Design Considerations and Imaging Setup for Liquid Fuel Droplet Detonation Wave Experiments
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Considerations for a facility to be used in detonation research, with a central objective being fuel droplet imaging in a detonation environment.

articleTitle: Developing Mid-Wave Infrared Photodetectors for Thermal Imaging with Colloidal Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Colloidal quantum dot infrared focal plane arrays for long-range thermal imaging are being developed by QDIR as a low-cost alternative to epitaxial detectors. In this paper, the status of mercury telluride colloidal quantum dot detectors, focal plane arrays, and their production will be presented.

articleTitle: High-resolution imaging for synthetic aperture radar
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We introduce a modification of the multiple signal classification method for synthetic aperture radar. This method uses both the signal and the noise sub-spaces of the data. It yields high-resolution and quantitative images and is shown to be robust with respect to random perturbations to the travel times.

articleTitle: Photon Doppler velocimetry in interdisciplinary shock compression studies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Detection of shock wave profiles in dynamic compression experiments is critical to several interdisciplinary areas. This paper focuses on the versatile nature of photon Doppler velocimetry (PDV) experiments, and their applications in probing shock-induced effects at the intersection of chemistry, physics, and geosciences.

articleTitle: High-Throughput Volumetric Microfabrication with Structured Light
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper describes a volumetric fabrication method developed for multiphoton polymerization (MPP) with orders-of-magnitude higher throughput than conventional approaches. Microstructures are fabricated using 3D sculpted light-fields. This advance moves us closer to MPP-based mass production of devices for photonics, microfluidics, and medicine.

articleTitle: Optical-Based Relative Electric Field Measurement in Dielectric Microwave Resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Here we present the experimental relative electric field magnitude mapping of a high permittivity cylindrical dielectric microwave resonator mode using an external superstrate optically induced conductance (OIC) technique. The fundamental TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01δ</inf> mode is mapped and compared to finite element method simulated fields with excellent agreement.

articleTitle: Flow rate profile based PFAS detection on smartphone- and paper-based microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Sensitive detection of PFOA, type of PFAS (perfluorinated-alkyl substances), was demonstrated on paper-based microfluidic chip utilizing competitive binding with albumin or casein and cellulose fibers. It altered the capillary flow rate profile and monitored by a smartphone camera. Detection limit was 1-10 fg/µL (1-10 ppt).

articleTitle: OAM-Based Optical Wavelet for Real-Time Probing and Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We present a method for experimentally generating optical fields that can be described as polar wavelets. The wavelets are used to sense the environment and obtain its wavelet transform, which gives localized OAM information in space.

articleTitle: Interband and Intraband Optical Gain in Colloidal Nanoplatelets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Two-dimensional nanoplatelets, or colloidal quantum wells, display large gain coefficients and low threshold amplified spontaneous emission and lasing thresholds spanning visible energies. In addition to interband gain via biexcitons, thresholdless intraband gain is observed with interband excitation in a quantum fountain-like population inversion.

articleTitle: Properties and principles of resonant optical lattices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The physical properties of resonant photonic lattices are reviewed. This includes the dynamics of the resonance modes and band structure explaining the characteristics of the leaky (radiant) and nonleaky (closed) band edges. An application primer is presented.

articleTitle: Label-Free Detection of Gamma-Aminobutryric Acid Biomarker Using Dielectrophoresis and Absorption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) is a potential biomarker for the detection of neurological disorders. In this work, we have investigated a method for label-free detection of GABA molecules.

articleTitle: Second Harmonic Generation Enhancement from Amorphous Silicon-Gallium Nitride based Guided Mode Resonant Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We study second harmonic generation (SHG) enhancement from 5 μm thick Gallium Nitride layer with amorphous silicon sub-wavelength gratings supporting guided-mode resonances. The enhanced SHG is attributed to the excitation of the in-plane nonlinear polarization resulting in efficient SHG collection.

articleTitle: Development and Testing of Amplifier Circuits for Infrared Scene Projectors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Infrared Scene Projectors require analog signals to be amplified from the output of Digital to Analog Converters to then power IRLEDs to display images on the Scene Projector. This paper highlights the testing of the current generation and development of the next generation of amplifiers.

articleTitle: Comparison of Air-Wedge Shearing vs Mach-Zehnder Interferometric Methods for Plasma Parameter Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This work provides insight into two experimental methods used for optical measurement of plasma parameters. An air-wedge shearing interferometer is compared against the Mach Zehnder technique. Extraction of plasma parameters is also discussed.

articleTitle: Novel Approaches to Infrared Detection in CMOS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper discusses three approaches to the detection of long-wavelength photons in microelectronic CMOS. The performance of (a) high-bandwidth, zero-biased SiGe detectors, (b) high-responsivity avalanche polysilicon detectors that utilize grain-boundary absorption, and (c) on-chip photovoltaic energy harvesting using silicon-oxide interface state absorption will be presented.

articleTitle: Center for Semiconductor Modeling (CSM) – Accelerating Technology Development through Understanding Fundamental and Technology Limitations in Materials and Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The Army Research Laboratory (ARL) and Boston University (BU) have established the Center for Semiconductor Modeling of Materials and Devices (CSM), bringing together government, academia, and industry in a collaborative fashion to continuously advance semiconductor research forward to meet DoD needs. The CSM leverages combined core competencies of partner organizations, which include a broad knowledge base in modeling, and its validation; sharing of computational, characterization, materials growth and device processing resources; and ‘extension of the bench’ via exchange of researchers between affiliated entities.

articleTitle: Dual-scale Engineering of Broadband Ultrablack Structures via Ultrafast Laser Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Materials with broadband ultralow optical reflectivity are useful for applications in diverse fields including defense, energy, and imaging. We experimentally demonstrate dual-scale surfaces comprising nm- and µm-scale features with measured total reflectivity less than 3% from 400 to 2000 nm.

articleTitle: Uncooled Infrared/Far-Infrared Thermopile Arrays for Space-Borne, Remote-Sensing Radiometry
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Thermal infrared instruments have proven integral components on payloads across the solar system, including the highlights below. The Voyager payload included the IRIS spectrometer [1] that provided our first views of the thermal emission spectra of several satellites, as well as the thermal emission and global heat balance of the four giant planets [1] . The Galileo payload included the Photopolarimeter-Radiometer PPR experiment that provided new constraints on the heat flow from Io and an upper limit on Europa [2] . The Cassini payload included the Composite Infrared Spectrometer (CIRS) that provided thermal and composition mapping of Saturn’s atmosphere and satellites, including Titan [3] and anomalous thermal emission due to active endogenic heat sources on Enceladus [4] . Mars remains a popular target for thermal infrared instruments dating back to the Infrared Thermal Mapper (IRTM) on the Viking orbiters, through the Mars Global Surveyor Thermal Emission Spectrometer (TES) to the current flight instruments: Thermal Emission Imaging System (THEMIS) on Mars Odyssey and MCS on MRO [5] , [6] . MCS is an atmospheric limb sounder that measures 4-D global fields of temperature, pressure, dust, and ices in the atmosphere of Mars, both day and night. Diviner on LRO [10] is providing a complete set of precise radiometric lunar surface temperature measurements over its full 30-400 K range, as well as constraints on physical and compositional properties.

articleTitle: System Improvements for Infrared LED Scene Projectors Applied to Non-Uniformity Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: As Infrared LED scene projector technology has matured, so have the techniques used to enhance Non-Uniformity Correction. This paper will detail the data collection and system improvements made for IRLED system NUC tables.

articleTitle: Strong Anti-Stokes Luminescence from Colloidal LiY1-xYbxF4 Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We have synthesized colloidal LiY<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</inf>Yb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> nanoparticles using a co-precipitation approach. Comprehensive structural characterization confirmed their actual composition was very close to the targeted composition, as determined by relative amounts of Y and Yb precursors. Strong anti-Stokes luminescence makes these nanoparticles attractive for laser-cooling applications.

articleTitle: Wafer-level active plasmonic nano-chains
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We here present wafer-scale electrochromic films made of active plasmonic nano-chains. These plasmonic nanochains are readily fabricated via three simple steps, i.e. wafer-scale thin-film growth, thermal dewetting, and conductive polymer coating. They show vivid color dynamics across the whole visible spectra.

articleTitle: Simulating Optical Response of Disordered Photonic Crystals Using the Discrete Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A new method is introduced for obtaining band diagrams for disordered photonic crystals using the discrete Fourier transform to obtain harmonic phase maps. The method overcomes limitations of conventional approaches, which assume perfect order and are inapplicable to the most interesting and experimentally realistic situations.

articleTitle: High-Speed Measurements of Detonation Wave-Induced Breakup and Combustion of Nitromethane Droplets
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The first high-speed imagery regarding the interaction of nitromethane (NM) droplets with a detonation wave (DW) are presented.

articleTitle: Cylindrical-Lens-Embedded Photonic Crystal Based on Self-Collimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Independent optical power and phase control is experimentally demonstrated in a self-collimating PC based on rod-into-wall unit cell and fabricated in a low-refractive-index medium by multiphoton lithography.

articleTitle: Active Nanophotonics with Nonvolatile Response: The Case for Phase-Change Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Reversible, nonvolatile, and pronounced refractive index modulation (0.5<∆n<3.5, 0<∆k<2.5) is an unprecedented combination of properties enabled by chalcogenide phase-change materials. From integrated phase and amplitude modulators to photonic in-memory computing cells, metasurfaces, and wavelength filters, these materials represent a fast-growing platform for active, low-energy nanophotonics.

articleTitle: Actively tunable angle-independent mid-infrared optical filters using GST Fabry-Perot resonators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Germanium antimony telluride (GST) properties and experimental results of mid-infrared optical filter are demonstrated. Incorporating sub-wavelength gratings of GST-Ag, Fabry-Perot resonators produce transmission peak are observed. Active tuning by, thermal excitation, of GST shifts refractive index from 3.48-4.61 while maintaining angular independence up to 60°.

articleTitle: Measurements of Reduced Scale Models for Testing 3D Synthetic Aperture Radar Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This paper presents an effort to develop data sets for testing 3D synthetic aperture radar (SAR) algorithms on ground vehicles. As part of this effort we present a multi-channel inverse SAR (ISAR) measurement of a reduced scale model truck in our radar test range.

articleTitle: Numerical Exploration of Organic Liquid-filled Fibers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Hollow capillary and antiresonant fibers infiltrated with organic liquids of good transparency in the short- to mid-wave infrared are numerically investigated. We present liquid mixture-controlled dispersion and loss features governed by the the fibers’ microstructure.

articleTitle: Low-Noise Chip-Based Photonic Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recent progress in heterogeneous integration has yielded fully integrated, electrically pumped lasers and micro-combs on silicon substrates with record low noise. We review these demonstrations together with developments in chip-based compact reference cavities as key pieces in building low-noise RF photonic oscillators.

articleTitle: Interband Cascade LEDs Grown on Silicon
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Epi-up interband cascade light emitting devices grown on 4° offcut silicon exhibit efficiencies 75% of those for epi-down ICLEDs grown on GaSb when differences in architecture are accounted for. At 100 mA, 200-μm-diameter mesas produce 184 μW cw at 25°C and 140 μW at 85°C.

articleTitle: Performance Limits of an Optical Fiber Communication System with Third-Order Solitons
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We show that a single-channel optical fiber communication system based on nonlinear frequency division multiplexing (NFDM) with three solitons can only achieve 0.6 dBm of launch power with lumped amplification by erbium-doped fiber amplifiers over 1, 600 km of propagation distance.

articleTitle: Underwater Oculometry for Diver Physiology and Neurocognitive Assessment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: An oculometric neurologic assessment tool developed to integrate a non-invasive, diver/subject worn test system that can rapidly and repeatedly evaluate the underseas related efforts on neurologic function. The tool will be used for its ability to capture eye movement patterns while wearing a diver mask.

articleTitle: Target Pose Estimation from Dual-Plane Speckle Return
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We explore the potential for measuring size, distance, and tilt orientation of a simplified target from its returned speckle patterns in the pupil and image planes of a generalized imaging system. Our results show that such measurements are possible to within a 10% error bound.

articleTitle: Template Matching Study on Synthetic Aperture RADAR and Synthetic Aperture LADAR Imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The difference in performance of template matching algorithms on synthetic aperture LADAR and synthetic aperture RADAR imagery is assessed empirically on a variety of operating conditions and algorithm parameters. Key interactions between algorithm parameters and operating conditions are identified and explored for both modalities.

articleTitle: Frequency Tuning of Perfect Absorbing Metamaterial using a Thin Conformal Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Metamaterials, in the form of perfect absorbers, have received attention for sensing and light harvesting applications. Reciprocal plasmonic metasurfaces allow frequency tuning in simple post-fabrication processes. Here we demonstrate this tuning using thin conformal dielectric coatings deposited using atomic layer deposition.

articleTitle: Effects on Communications Wavelengths from an Atmospheric Nuclear Detonation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We model the elevated free electron density of the atmosphere from a nuclear detonation as a function of time and examine how the electromagnetic spectrum is affected.

articleTitle: Considerations for Electrically-Pumped Quantum Hall Effect Topological Laser Arrays
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Recent demonstrations of topological lasers in the C-band based on emulation of the quantum Hall effect show possibility for low-threshold, highly-unidirectional lasers suitable for integrated photonics. Techniques for design and fabrication of electrically-pumped topological lasers arrays are presented.

articleTitle: One-Dimensional Photonic Crystals with Narrow-Band Defect Modes Fabricated by Direct Laser Writing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: One-dimensional photonic crystals incorporating a defect layer were fabricated using two-photon polymerization. The introduction of a defect layer induced a narrow transmission band within the photonic bandgap. Fabrication, characterization, as well as potential applications of these photonic crystals are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Guide to Duplicating the Picatinny STEM Liquid Nitrogen Roadshow
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Picatinny researchers and teachers have fine-tuned a world-class, mobile science outreach show. The demonstrations center on the gas laws, but there are many side experiments. Safe and effective handling of liquid nitrogen and of the equipment are stressed. Opportunities for apprenticeship ride-alongs or for coaching offered.

articleTitle: Compressed Optical Streaking for Diffraction Limited Magnetic Field Video Recording
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This work proposes a method for acquiring fast dynamic micro-scale magnetic field video by combining compressed optical streaking ultra-fast photography and nitrogen vacancy magnetometry. Compressed isomagnetic ring propagation from a magnetic monopole antenna was simulated and video was reconstructed from a single image.

articleTitle: Edge-Illuminated Monochromatic Photovoltaic Array for Galvanically-Isolated Power-Over-Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We used a micro-fabricated fused silica light guide plate to uniformly illuminate a GaAs photovoltaic array with a fiber-coupled 808 nm laser. Greater than 1 Watt of galvanically-isolated electrical power was generated from this compact edge-illuminated monochromatic photovoltaic module.

articleTitle: Neuronal Modeling Tool Using DynaSim
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Human cognitive processes remain an area of strong interest and ongoing research. One tool to gain greater insight into this process is neuronal modeling. The following features are desirable in a neuronal modeling tool: a library of known parameters for different neurons and species, the ability to select the neuron and species of interest, the ability to quickly simulate neuronal behavior, and the ability to calculate metabolic requirements and efficiencies for various neuronal activity. Many of these can be found in software today, but not all elements can be found in one entity. The goal of this work is to develop a neuronal modeling tool that incorporates these features.

articleTitle: Three-dimensionally shaped silicon nanostructures for ultraviolet plasmonics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Silicon, often known as a dielectric material, possesses metallic characteristics in the ultraviolet (UV) range and leads to intriguing novel optical interaction known as plasmonic resonance. We here theoretically and experimentally demonstrate UV plasmonic behaviors of various silicon nanostructures from simple spheres to complex helices.

articleTitle: Effect of Substrate Waves on Antireflection Performance of Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Reduced reflection by surfaces is realizable with subwavelength gratings. However, transmitted waves underneath the surfaces will directly affect the response and must be accounted for. Here, we model antireflection based on substrate waves grounded in lattice diffraction.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Infrared LEDs Through Standardized Integrated Duty Cycle Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In our latest infrared LED scene projector system, the power provided to the LEDs can be synchronously pulsed to various voltage levels, which reduces unwanted heating and radiance droop. This paper characterizes the effects of changing the duty cycle on the performance of the IRLEDs.

articleTitle: Single-shot microscope for simultaneous determination of fifteen cellular biophysical parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Cytometry is a ubiquitous tool in biological sciences, allowing rapid determination of cellular health. We present a single-shot microscope capable of simultaneously determining fifteen biophysical parameters, including the cellular water content (by mass and volume), longitudinal modulus, refractive index, mass density, and other parameters.

articleTitle: Thin Film Surface Reconstruction from Interferometry Curvature Measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: This work presents a new technique for surface reconstruction based on curvature measurements. The method is robust in the geometries it can handle while also exhibiting processing times of 131 milliseconds for a 768x768 pixel image.

articleTitle: Porous Silicon Optical Biosensor for Malaria
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We demonstrate detection of the malaria biomarker PfHRP2 using a porous silicon (PSi) optical biosensor. Specificity was achieved with anti-PFHRP2 antibodies "clicked" to an azide-containing polymeric film grafted from the PSi surface. This work showcases the potential of PSi biosensors for clinically relevant diagnostics.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a metalens with a hexagonal array of intersecting-wall meta-atoms for operation in the near-infrared
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: A metalens with a hexagonal array of intersecting-wall meta-atoms was designed for operation at a wavelength of 1.550 μm with a new meta-optics design tool (MODT) and fabricated in the photopolymer IP-Dip by multi-photon lithography.

articleTitle: Hybridizing THz Time-Domain Spectroscopy with Artificial Intelligence for Conductivity Prediction of Various Nanowires
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: Through an example of calculating the conductivity of nanowire samples utilizing THz-TDS, we report artificial intelligence assures a fast, reliable, and cost-effective way of performing data analysis. Combining AI techniques with THz-TDS will benefit the future application of THz-based applications by increasing their popularity.

articleTitle: A Review of the Machine Learning Algorithms used with High-Density Surface Electromyogram Sensors for Lower Extremity Exoskeletons and Prosthetics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: High-Density Surface Electromyogram (HDsEMG) sensors are increasingly being used to evaluate the neuromusculoskeletal function associated with exoskeletons and prosthetics. The ML algorithms used to sense the intention of movement and to control the assisted movement of exoskeletons or prosthetics in the lower extremity are reviewed.

articleTitle: High-speed free-space transmission at room temperature with an RF-mounted quantum cascade laser emitting in the long-wave infrared domain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We report on a room-temperature transmission with a long-wave infrared quantum cascade laser emitting at 8.1 µm. With 4-level pulse amplitude modulation and digital signal processing, maximum data rate of 4.8 Gbps is achieved.

articleTitle: Negative Refractive Index in Si-Based Fishnet Stack at Optical Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: We design and numerically study the optical properties of a novel metamaterial structure made of a stack of Si/porous SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> slab fishnets on Si substrate. Negative refractive index is obtained in the wavelength range of 0.92 – 2 μm, with the minimum of -4.8.

articleTitle: Modeling the Self-Capacitance of Individual Plates in a Multi-Conductor System using PEEC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In many areas of electronics design, it is necessary to understand the different aspects of capacitance associated with various conducting surfaces in a particular layout. This is because as operating frequencies increase and dimensions decrease, capacitive coupling can become the dominant means in which noise is induced in a design. Therefore, having the ability to extract an equivalent circuit for modeling capacitive coupling and understanding the coupling can be very important, and challenging. This paper presents insight on capacitive coupling by evaluating the capacitance between two parallel plates, with particular attention paid to the self-capacitance (with a reference at infinity) of each of the individual plates. More specifically, the Partial Element Equivalent Circuit (PEEC) method is used to compute the self-capacitance of each individual plate in the parallel plate capacitor problem, and results are verified by comparison to values from James C. Maxwell’s original works and the electrostatic solver ANSYS Maxwell 3D. Overall, it is shown how the self-capacitance of each individual plate changes as a function of distance between the parallel plates.

articleTitle: The influence of alumina particle size on the fluid dynamics of a laser-induced plasma
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: The interaction of a laser-induced shock wave with nanoparticles and microparticles of aluminum oxide is investigated through experiments and modeling. The chemistry and physics of the interaction between the particles and plasma generated from laser ablation shows similarities and discrete differences for the two particle sizes. For both particle sizes, early stage (less than 10 microseconds) ionization was dominant and evidenced by higher concentrations of Al II. While both sizes exhibit ionization over the same duration, the intensity of emission was greater for nanoparticles indicating greater concentrations of ionized species. Moreover, the dispersion of species was notably more elongated for microparticles while radial dispersion was more pronounced for nanoparticles with elevated drag forces. At later stages (i.e., greater than 10 microseconds), oxidation reactions were dominant for both particle sizes, but the same distinctions in flow field were observed and attributed to particle drag. In all stages of interaction, microparticles expand axially with less drag that suppresses their radial expansion. As a result, the dispersion of reactive species was mapped over an up to 80 perccent larger area for nanoparticles relative to microparticles. Results shown here can be applied toward advancing experimental diagnostics and particle-shock wave modeling and simulation efforts for energetic materials.

articleTitle: Metasurfaces with multipole Mie lattice resonances
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Research and Applications of Photonics in Defense Conference (RAPID)
abstract: In this work, we aim at designing efficient directional scatterers and their arrays for metasurfaces and transdimensional metastructures. The combination of different materials in the nanoparticle allows to tune electric and magnetic resonances of the nanoparticles and achieve broadband overlap.
